Disability-welfare registrations · District scope

29 Section 51 certificate copies described in the source collection

Legal framework
RPwD Act, 2016 · Section 51
Departments
District welfare / disability-empowerment authorities
Source grouping
Eight districts · Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
Current-status basis
Certificate dates and renewals require centre-level review

What this supports

The source collection contains district-specific institution-registration copies. Four selected originals are documented below; the September handout groups the broader collection.

Scope & limits

These are separate institution records, not one nationwide DDEW licence. A network count should not be treated as proof that all centres hold current registrations.

The handout groups 19 copies within stated 2027–2030 date ranges and 10 on a renewal calendar. Current renewal originals and issuer status must be checked individually.
